p: The Patient Story section - inherited from ISO 27269 and FHIR IPS IG - "contains narrative text along with optional resources that express what matters to a patient. This may include needs, strengths, values, concerns and preferences to others providing supportand care. The patient’s story, provided here, may be told by the patient or by a proxy"

While, the Patient History - derived from the eHN PS Guidelines A.2.2.3 Medical history (not to be confused with the overarching structure A.2.2 Medical history) - "may provide both synthetic anamnesis (e.g. description of phases of the pathology as a chronological summary of clustered clinical information) and anecdotal evidence that clinicians can collect from the patient, and can read in a narrative form. See Section 2, Chapter III, Art 7, (c)."

Participants acting on behalf of the patient (delegated participants), for example a person who authors the Patient Summary (Composition.author) on behalf of the patient, are represented by using the RelatedPerson resource.

In this version of the guide, to distinguish the personal relationship with the patient (e.g. father) from the role the person plays on behalf of the patient (e.g. guardian), more instances of the RelatedPerson.relationship element are used: one for the relationship and one for the role.
